parameters.jsCode: const rows=$input.all().map(x=>x.json||{}),batches=$('Screen and Prepare Sources').all().map(x=>x.json||{}); const expected=batches.flatMap(b=>b.candidateIds||[]),expectedSet=new Set(expected); if(expectedSet.size!==expected.length)throw new Error('Duplicate candidate IDs across prepared batches.'); const byBatchId=new Map(); for(const row of rows){if(!row.batch_id)continue;if(row.research_run_id!==batches[0]?.researchRunId)throw new Error('Checkpoint belongs to a different research run: '+row.batch_id);const prior=byBatchId.get(row.batch_id);if(prior){if(prior.id!==row.id||JSON.stringify(prior)!==JSON.stringify(row))throw new Error('Conflicting duplicate checkpoint records: '+row.batch_id);continue;}byBatchId.set(row.batch_id,row);} const seen=new Set(),claims=[],missing=[],unresolved=[]; for(const batch of batches){const row=byBatchId.get(batch.batchId);if(!row||row.status!=='completed'||!row.result){missing.push(batch.batchId);if(row)unresolved.push({batchId:row.batch_id,status:row.status,primaryAttempts:Number(row.primary_attempts||0),recoveryAttempts:Number(row.recovery_attempts||0),errorMessage:row.error_message||null});continue;}const result=typeof row.result==='string'?JSON.parse(row.result):row.result;if(result.researchRunId!==batch.researchRunId||result.batchId!==batch.batchId||result.batchCount!==batches.length||JSON.stringify(result.expectedCandidateIds)!==JSON.stringify(batch.candidateIds)||!Array.isArray(result.classifiedIds)||JSON.stringify(result.classifiedIds)!==JSON.stringify(batch.candidateIds)||!['openrouter','nvidia'].includes(result.providerPath))throw new Error('Invalid checkpoint result: '+batch.batchId);for(const id of result.classifiedIds){if(!expectedSet.has(id)||seen.has(id))throw new Error('Unexpected or duplicate candidate: '+id);seen.add(id);}if(Array.isArray(result.claims))claims.push(...result.claims);} const missingCandidates=expected.filter(id=>!seen.has(id));if(missing.length||missingCandidates.length)throw new Error('Global extraction incomplete: '+missing.length+' batches and '+missingCandidates.length+' candidates unresolved. '+JSON.stringify(unresolved));if(!claims.length)return [{json:{noClaims:true,researchRunId:batches[0]?.researchRunId,acceptedCount:0,classifiedCandidateCount:seen.size,batchCount:batches.length}}];return claims.map(c=>({json:c}));

const old=$input.all().map(x=>x.json||{}); const known=new Set(old.map(x=>String(x.batch_id||''))); const batches=$('Screen and Prepare Sources').all().map(x=>x.json||{}); const missing=batches.filter(x=>!known.has(x.batchId)); if(!missing.length)return [{json:{skipInsert:true}}]; return missing.map(x=>({json:{research_run_id:x.researchRunId,batch_id:x.batchId,batch_index:x.batchIndex,batch_count:x.batchCount,candidate_ids:x.candidateIds,status:'pending',primary_attempts:0,recovery_attempts:0}}));

const rows=$input.all().map(x=>x.json||{}); const batches=$('Screen and Prepare Sources').all().map(x=>x.json||{}); const byId=new Map(rows.filter(x=>x.batch_id).map(x=>[String(x.batch_id),x])); const MAX_PRIMARY_ATTEMPTS=2,MAX_RECOVERY_ATTEMPTS=2; const retryable=[],exhausted=[]; for(const batch of batches){const row=byId.get(String(batch.batchId));if(!row)throw new Error('Missing batch ledger row: '+batch.batchId);if(row.status==='completed')continue;const primaryAttempts=Number(row.primary_attempts||0),recoveryAttempts=Number(row.recovery_attempts||0);if(primaryAttempts>=MAX_PRIMARY_ATTEMPTS||recoveryAttempts>=MAX_RECOVERY_ATTEMPTS){exhausted.push({batchId:batch.batchId,status:row.status,primaryAttempts,recoveryAttempts,errorMessage:row.error_message||null});continue;}retryable.push({json:{...batch,primaryAttempts,recoveryAttempts,ledgerRowId:row.id,attemptHistory:Array.isArray(row.attempt_history)?row.attempt_history:[]}});} if(retryable.length)return retryable;if(exhausted.length)return [{json:{allCompleted:true,retryExhausted:true,exhaustedBatches:exhausted}}];return [{json:{allCompleted:true}}];

const batch=$('Loop Over Extraction Batches').item.json; const ledger=$('Mark Batch Processing').item.json||{}; const attemptHistory=Array.isArray(ledger.attempt_history)?ledger.attempt_history:(Array.isArray(batch.attemptHistory)?batch.attemptHistory:[]); return [{json:{...batch,attemptHistory,processingStartedAt:ledger.started_at||ledger.updated_at||new Date().toISOString()}}];
